create_flat_clipper: create a UserUpdateClipper instance with a max_norm value to clip FL user updates using flat clipping
create_adaptive_clipper: create an AdaptiveClipper with ClippingSetting to perform adaptive clipping based on unclipped fraction quantile
clip_model_diff: clip a model diff in-place by computing the clip factor and rescaling each parameter
calc_model_diff: calculate the difference between a new model and previous model for FL update clipping
update_clipper_stats: update the adaptive clipper stats to adjust the clipping bound based on the noisy unclipped fraction
